user.title: Connect to an Allen & Heath iDR
user.description: Enter the address of the network port of the iDR. The unit must run firmware V3.50 or later, which is required for the Telnet control protocol.

data_description.host: The IP address of the iDR network port.
data_description.port: The Telnet port of the iDR. This is 23 unless you changed it.
data_description.password: Only needed when a password has been set on the iDR.

reauth_confirm.title: Password required
reauth_confirm.description: The iDR at {host} requires a password. Enter the current password.

reconfigure.title: Change connection settings
reconfigure.description: Change how Home Assistant connects to the iDR.

data_description.host: The IP address of the iDR network port.
data_description.port: The Telnet port of the iDR. This is 23 unless you changed it.
data_description.password: Only needed when a password has been set on the iDR.

error.cannot_connect: Cannot connect to the iDR. Check the IP address and the network connection.
error.invalid_auth: The password is missing or wrong.
error.invalid_response: The device did not answer like an iDR. Check that it runs firmware V3.50 or later.
error.already_configured: An iDR with this address and port is already set up.

abort.already_configured: An iDR with this address and port is already set up.

init.title: Channels and controls
init.description: Choose which channels and controls are created. The iDR always has 16 input and 16 output channels, but only the channels that are wired need an entity.

data_description.inputs: Input channels 1 up to this number get a gain and mute entity.
data_description.outputs: Output channels 1 up to this number get a gain and mute entity.
data_description.expose_groups: Create gain entities for the 8 input groups, 8 output groups and 16 crosspoint groups.
data_description.expose_crosspoints: Create a gain and mute entity for every crosspoint (inputs x outputs). This can be a lot of entities.
data_description.scan_interval: How often the state of the iDR is read, in seconds.

command_failed.message: The iDR could not be updated: {error}

not_applied.message: The iDR did not apply the value {requested}. It reports {actual}.

device_not_found.message: No Allen & Heath iDR device found for {device_id}.

crosspoint_needs_gain_or_mute.message: Provide a gain, a mute, or both.

set_crosspoint.name: Set crosspoint
set_crosspoint.description: Set the gain and/or mute of one crosspoint (an input routed to an output) on the iDR's routing matrix. At least one of gain or mute must be given. Works even if the crosspoint entities are not enabled for this device.

gain.name: Gain
gain.description: The gain in dB, or "off" to switch the crosspoint off completely (-infinity).
